sections.title: Sound of the letter zé
paragraphs: The letter name is (zé) /zsɛ/. It mainly sounds as in (zöld) /ˈzøld/, which means green. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: How to say zé
paragraphs: First, bring your teeth close together. Put your tongue near the ridge behind your upper teeth. Push air through the narrow gap. Make the sound voiced, so your voice is on. Touch your throat and you feel it shake. For the other sound, keep the same mouth position. Turn your voice off so your throat does not shake.

sections.title: Spelling rules for zé
paragraphs: In standard positions, the letter is voiced. You hear this sound in (zene) /ˈzɛnɛ/. Before voiceless consonants, it changes to a voiceless sound. You also hear this voiceless sound at the end of a word before a pause. Hear it in (kéz) /ˈkeːz/.

sections.title: Mistakes with zé
paragraphs: Do not turn the voiced sound into the sh sound in ship. Keep your tongue forward against the ridge behind your upper teeth. Always buzz your voice firmly, as in the English word zoo. When it stands before a voiceless consonant, let the voice switch off completely, like the s sound in bus.
